title: A document that declares WordprocessingML as the default namespace below its root cannot be edited
symptom: a document whose body, a table or a block content control declares the default namespace (`<w:body xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main">`, its elements written without a prefix) opens, reads and saves unchanged, but an edit of its main part is refused, naming this limitation; the default namespace on the document root, a paragraph, a run, a row, a cell or a link is edited as any other writing
workaround: open and save the document in Word or LibreOffice, which write the `w:` prefix, then edit the saved copy
